register_pre_dispatch_hook: register a pre-dispatch hook on a BaseDispatcher to transform hidden states and topk output before dispatch
register_post_dispatch_hook: register a post-dispatch hook on a BaseDispatcher to inspect or modify the dispatch output after dispatch
register_pre_combine_hook: register a pre-combine hook on a BaseDispatcher to transform combine input before combine
register_post_combine_hook: register a post-combine hook on a BaseDispatcher to inspect or modify hidden states after combine
check_dispatch_output_format: check the format of a DispatchOutput using DispatchOutputChecker type-guard methods like format_is_standard or format_is_deepep
